# NetworkDynamicalStabilization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of control-theoretic feedback to prevent runaway or oscillatory centrality dynamics in neuromorphic networks, ensuring stable information processing. Critical for maintaining reliable spike-timing and synaptic plasticity in in-network neuromorphic substrates where dynamic centrality can destabilize learning.
